caption:
A few everyday things worth checking this week.

Number 1 is easy to miss. Most of us drink far more tea and coffee than water in winter, and the skin under your eyes is thin enough to show it first.

Number 2 is the one that gets me. A salty Friday takeaway makes your body hold on to extra water, and my face is puffy till Sunday.

Save this for your next tired-face morning, and send it to the friend who always says she looks shattered.
